title: Austin Approves Town Lake Parade in One Minute
summary:
*   Austin's governing body convened a special meeting which concluded in just one minute.
*   They swiftly approved a parade permit for the "Town Lake Citizen's" group.
*   The parade was scheduled for the following day, June 10, 1978, from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.
*   The approved route covered streets in the area around Town Lake (now Lady Bird Lake).
